name: Capsim (Capstone / CapsimCore)
description: Commercial online business simulation widely used in business school education. Students manage competing firms in a simulated market with emergent competitive dynamics. Used by 1,000+ institutions worldwide as a capstone business education tool.
evaluation_method: balanced scorecard metrics, market share, financial performance
general_score_metric: composite business performance score (balanced scorecard: combined financial, market-share and operational metrics)
notes: Used by 1,000+ institutions worldwide. Available in Capstone (full) and CapsimCore (streamlined) versions.
